page.layout: One scanned image: the inside of a book cover, patterned red-and-cream marbled or block-printed paper with a dark background and a spine strip at the right edge. No printed text block.
page.notes: The scan shows only the decorative endpaper or cover paper of the binding: a repeating red floral/diamond pattern on cream paper. No printed words, page number, running head, catchword or signature are visible. The narrow strip at the right edge is the spine and binding, with a few partial marks (a gilt or label fragment) that are not legible as printed text and are therefore not transcribed.
